authority: Disposable hypothetical states only; no real queue, grant, root or effect. Expected states are proposed static consequences, not disposition or migration authority.

cases.title: Prepared unentered restart
preconditions: effect EF-1 prepared for input I-1
expected_durable_state: plan EF-1 remains prepared
only fresh exact authority and fences may admit entry

cases.title: Entered claim and lost start
preconditions: attempt AT-2 for EF-2 durably entered
incarnation INC-2 and operation OP-2 recorded
cases.crash_cut: after entry commit, before send or before start response
expected_durable_state: EnteredUncertain
query-only readback bound to AT-2/INC-2/OP-2

cases.title: Terminal failure with unsettled effect
expected_durable_state: failure visible promptly
queue blocked until settlement/recovery authority resolves dependent effect
forbidden_entries: equate process exit with remote settlement

cases.title: Persisted result, lost acknowledgment
preconditions: result RES-4 persisted with exact bytes hash
cases.crash_cut: after result commit before client acknowledgment
expected_durable_state: read/replay exact RES-4 bytes under original identity
changed bytes under AT-4 conflict

cases.title: No-retry disposition authority race
cases.crash_cut: before retirement commit while authority/current claim changes
observed_facts: stale observation revision or narrowed/expired grant or unresolved required effects or competing launch
expected_durable_state: refuse stale/unauthorized retirement
only separately authorized exact claim may record RetiredNoRetry as retirement, never success
open_owner_decisions: trust/signing policy and exact recovery authority

cases.title: Late contrary evidence after retirement
expected_durable_state: preserve retirement history and original evidence
re-fence dependent admission
expose performed consequence for incident accounting

cases.title: Coherent SQLite/WAL export
preconditions: disposable source has committed WAL pages and referenced artifacts
cases.crash_cut: export cut between WAL and main-file checkpoint
observed_facts: coherent source snapshot includes committed WAL state
expected_durable_state: export one coherent snapshot with referenced artifacts and identities
preparation performs no import or mutation

cases.title: Inactive adoption and single admission owner
preconditions: handoff HD-8 has pinned source revision and path/file identities
cases.crash_cut: four cuts: before inactive acceptance; after acceptance before source fence; after fence before selection CAS; after CAS before destination ownership commit
observed_facts: A: destination absent or inactive; B: inactive accepted capsule; C: source fenced, destination inactive; D: selection points candidate but destination still inactive
expected_durable_state: A: no destination owner; B: source alone owns admission; C: neither destination nor unfenced source may newly admit; D: exact retry may finish original HD-8, conflict stays inactive; after ownership commit only destination admits
at most one admission owner at every cut
forbidden_entries: new handoff identity on exact retry
open_owner_decisions: destination owning API and launch-manifest CAS semantics

cases.title: Rollback after candidate-current work
preconditions: candidate owns L-9 after accepted handoff
cases.crash_cut: rollback requested after candidate has performed work
observed_facts: candidate-current snapshot includes I-1, I-2, I-3 and dedup receipts
expected_durable_state: stopped candidate exports current state
compatible target retains I-1 completion/no replay, I-2 uncertainty/no resend, I-3 pending
if target incompatible require explicit forward recovery or proven transfer
open_owner_decisions: rollback compatibility range and transfer owner

cases.title: Deployment and launcher fencing
preconditions: old executable or future schema may be present
manifest/root alias and path identities pinned
cases.crash_cut: selection changes or symlink swaps before spawn; spawn attempted before registration
observed_facts: mismatch between expected and actual executable/schema/root/selection
expected_durable_state: composed launcher/store refuses effect admission
S9 actual deployment proof remains required
forbidden_entries: treat component fixture as permanent proof

cases.title: Unknown or ambiguous import codec
preconditions: source bytes pinned under declared codec C-11
cases.crash_cut: codec decoder unavailable, wrong domain or alternative digest appears matching
observed_facts: source codec identity or domain fails exact match
expected_durable_state: reject unknown/ambiguous codec and wrong domain
if later owner selects import, preserve original bytes/hash and explicit new-identity lineage
forbidden_entries: try alternate codecs until one parses
open_owner_decisions: supported source codec list and compatibility

open_packet_decisions: S9 permanent deployment and rollback owner
